# Pixel Memory Match

A pixel memory-match game with 8 pairs of colored cards. Flip two cards at a time, matched pairs stay open, count your moves, and try to win with the fewest moves possible.

## Features

- 8 pairs of colored cards (16 cards total)
- Flip two at a time; matched pairs stay open
- Move counter increments per pair attempt
- Win message with total moves
- New Game button to reset and reshuffle
- Keyboard accessible: all cards are native buttons with labels
- Responsive layout works from 360px wide
- Cohesive dark palette with hover, focus, and pressed states

## How to Run

No build step or server required. Open `index.html` directly in any modern browser.

## Files

- `index.html` – page structure
- `styles.css` – theming and layout
- `game.js` – game logic

## Controls

- Click or tap a card to flip it
- Use Tab to focus cards, Enter/Space to flip
- Click **New Game** to reset
